sloka: आक्रोशं मम मातुश्च प्रमृज्य पुरुषर्षभ ।अद्य तत्रभवन्तं च पितरं रक्ष किल्बिषात् ॥ २.१०६.३०॥
transliteration: ākrośaṁ mama mātuśca pramṛjya puruṣarṣabha ।adya tatrabhavantaṁ ca pitaraṁ rakṣa kilbiṣāt ॥ 2.106.30॥

translations.english: O best of men, wiping out all the censure on my mother, redeem our revered father from sin.
